result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue in the bottom navigation bar where the 'Orders' tab is missing its icon.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon, leaving blank space above the 'Orders' label while the other tabs (Home, Search, Profile) all display icons.
issues.suggestion: Add the appropriate orders icon above the 'Orders' label in the bottom navigation bar so it matches the styling and layout of the other navigation items.
